subject: CloudShift discovery recap — exec handshake + deep-dive options
body:
From: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Javier Ortiz <javier.ortiz@cloudshift.ai>, Anika Meyers <anika.m@cloudshift.ai>
Cc: lauren_bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, marcus_lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: CloudShift discovery recap — exec handshake + deep-dive options

Hi Javier & Anika,

Thanks again for a productive discovery earlier today — good to understand the three priority use cases you called out (real-time anomaly scoring, historical embeddings for search, and nightly batch reranking for personalization). Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can keep momentum: 

Recap (from our side):
- Goals: reduce query latency for real-time scoring to <120ms P95, improve recommendations hit rate by ~8-12%, and cut per-query cost on batch rerank by ~30%.
- Constraints: VPC-only deployment, SOC2 evidence required, and existing model weights must remain on-prem for the pilot.
- Success metric: end-to-end P95 latency under target on sample workload + cost delta report.

Next steps (options to unblock internal stakeholders):
1) Executive alignment (30m): VP/CTO handshake — high level runbook, success criteria, risk/controls. Ideal to have your CTO in this slot so we can sign off on architecture boundaries.
2) Technical deep-dive (60m): Infra + ML engineering — kernel selection, quantization tradeoffs, and data paths. More hands-on; we can bring in our runtime lead.

Proposed slots (your timezone):
- Thu Sep 16, 10:00–10:30am PT (Exec)
- Fri Sep 17, 9:00–10:00am PT (Tech deep-dive)
- Mon Sep 20, 2:00–2:30pm PT (Exec)

If you prefer, pick one slot and we’ll lock it. I’m attaching a one-page mutual action plan that lays out milestones for a 6–8 week pilot.

Attachments: CloudShift_MAP_v1.pdf (MAP summary)

Thanks — looking forward to the next step.

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0123

Karthik — thanks for the concise recap.

The team prefers the Exec handshake first so our CTO (Sanjay) understands the guardrails. Thu Sep 16 at 10:00am PT works for Javier + Anika; can Sanjay join? He’s available briefly at that time.

Also: can you share a short agenda for the 30m slot so I can circulate to Sanjay + procurement?

Best,
Javier
Javier Ortiz
VP Product, CloudShift Analytics
javier.ortiz@cloudshift.ai

- 0:00–0:05 — introductions and objectives (VP/CTO + exec owners)
- 0:05–0:12 — business priorities & success metrics (Javier)
- 0:12–0:22 — high-level deployment options (hosted vs dedicated vs private) + security snapshot (Karthik)
- 0:22–0:28 — risks, timelines, and pilot milestones (mutual action plan)

Attendees we propose from Redwood: Karthik Iyer (AE), Marcus Lin (Solutions Engineer), Lauren Bishop (Customer Success). Please confirm if Sanjay (CTO) will join; if not, we can run and record the session and schedule the technical deep-dive with your infra team the following week.
